description: Proposal A. A failure is classed by the two states of the run that disagree: what an agent knows (K), the board (L), what an agent has received (Lⁱ), its reading of who does what (Gⁱ), the workspace (X), and time. Four classes are safety conditions a board can guarantee; two are liveness conditions it can only expose.

groups.name: Unsaid
groups.definition: Something an agent knows or did, which another agent's work needs, never reaches the board, or reaches it too late.
groups.evidence: the agent's own log shows it knew or did it; the board does not
groups.fix: none can force it; a board can prompt and expose it

groups.name: Unreceived
groups.definition: A post is on the board, or meant to be, but not in what the acting agent had received when it acted.
groups.evidence: wakes.ndjson (what each turn was handed) against room.ndjson
groups.fix: delivery, and a notice when a post supersedes one an agent is acting on

groups.name: Misread
groups.definition: An agent received the posts, but its reading drops what they established or adds what they did not.
groups.evidence: the agent's next act contradicts what it had received
groups.fix: projection: hand each agent the state, not only the posts

groups.name: Disagreement
groups.definition: Agents that received the same posts read different coordination from them: who owns what, what the work is, what was decided.
groups.evidence: two agents act on incompatible readings of the same prefix of the board
groups.fix: naming: typed acts, and acts that state what the work is

groups.name: Ungrounded
groups.definition: What the readings record as done, delivered, reviewed or true is not what the workspace holds.
groups.evidence: each seat's own log and the checks against its claims (facts_v1)
groups.fix: check: the board verifies before it records

groups.name: Stalled
groups.definition: Every reading may be right and shared, yet the coordination stops moving towards done, or the run ends at the wrong time.
groups.evidence: the sequence of coordination acts: no progress, a waiting cycle, open items at the end
groups.fix: none can force it; a board can expose it

groups.name: Overhead
groups.definition: Posts and work that change nothing. Counted as cost, not as failure.
groups.evidence: posts and commands that change no state

out_of_scope.anchoring: every state agrees and is grounded; the team simply chose badly together. A failure of collective judgement, not of communication.
out_of_scope.injection: adversarial: the model assumes agents that cooperate.
